text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] OpalTech (tenant: opaltech-prod) elevated 5xx rate on Dedicated cluster eu-west-2. 5m avg 5xx rate 12% (>5% threshold). Alert ID: RB-INC-32405. Automated reroute candidates listed.

jessica-m: acked. getting timeline + figuring customer impact. @matt_sre @kevin-platform please join, paging SRE. setting incident priority P1 due to customer SLA risk.

matt_sre: on it. looking at console metrics now — seeing 502/504 + backend timeouts, tail latencies spiking at the gateway layer. Is this localized to opaltech or cluster-wide?

kevin-platform: looks tenant-specific. KV cache eviction rates are through the roof for node pool dc-eu-west-2-pool-3. suspect "kvcache thrash" from a noisy tenant (opal-logger) causing qdepth and request queuing.

omar-eng: customer reports throughput drop -> may retry and then hit 5xx. can we get a top-20 keys eviction list?

kevin-platform: pulling logs. snippet from kv-proxy (truncated):

```
2026-07-09T02:17:03Z kv-proxy[pool-3] WARN eviction: tenant=opaltech key=ctx-9f3b evict_reason=mem_pressure age_ms=1243
2026-07-09T02:17:03Z kv-proxy[pool-3] WARN eviction: tenant=opal-logger key=events-2026-07-09-02 evict_reason=mem_pressure age_ms=12
2026-07-09T02:17:04Z gateway[svc] ERROR tenant=opaltech upstream=worker-12 conn_reset=true
```

kevin-platform: also seeing repeated prefix cache misses for opaltech model shards, so frequent cold loads into GPU memory -> GPU OOM/reloads sometimes causing worker restarts.

matt_sre: immediate mitigations we can do: 1) route opaltech to fallback pool (warm-fallback in eu-west-3) 2) temporarily bump tenant rate-limit (soft throttle) 3) pin opaltech kv shards or increase kv quota for opaltech. Which is fastest?

jessica-m: prioritize quick customer relief: route override + soft throttle. pinning kv shards is higher-risk, need platform approval.

matt_sre: I'll apply route override now.

matt_sre: running route update CLI:

```
# route-ctl: create override
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_API_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"opaltech","from":"dc-eu-west-2","to":"opaltech-fallback-eu-west-3","duration_minutes":60}' \
  https://console.redwood.ai/internal/v1/route-overrides
```

matt_sre: override accepted, traffic shifting (gradual) to opaltech-fallback-eu-west-3. watching metrics — beginning to see 5xx drop at the gateway after ~45s.

kevin-platform: good. while we shift, I'm going to apply a soft tenant throttle to prevent regeneration bursts from opal-logger app. command: `tenantctl set-rate opaltech 60rps --soft`

kevin-platform: applied soft throttle (60rps). also increasing kv quota for opaltech by +25% as a short-term buffer. doing that now.

omar-eng: FYI customer impact: OpalTech reported 1.2k active inference sessions, most affected were long-poll streaming sessions. ops told me some customers saw partial outputs then 504s. I've notified OpalTech CSM.

deepa-plat: investigating root cause. initial hypothesis: a downstream ingestion job (opal-logger) started a high-cardinality write pattern that evicted the prefix/KV entries used for model KV cache. This caused frequent reloads and increased GPU memory churn. we'll need to throttle/log the logger app. recommend a follow-up runbook item to add tenant-level KV write throttles and promote per-tenant pinned shards for heavy tenants.

kevin-platform: adding runbook note: RB-32405-KV. suggested medium-term: implement tenant pinning endpoint and guardrails (max pinned shards per tenant), plus autoscaler backoff for GPU churn.

matt_sre: confirming mitigations: 1) route override -> done. 2) soft throttle -> done. 3) kv quota bump -> done. Observed 5xx drop from 12% -> 2.1% in last 5m on opaltech. Gateway tail latency down.

jessica-m: nice work. OpalTech reported partial recovery in support channel. CSM standing by for follow-up. Notifying product security for potential noisy-tenant policy update.

omar-eng: can we keep opaltech on fallback pool for 60m and monitor? also we should avoid full migration until kv eviction pattern addressed — fallback pool has warm kvcache copies but not pinned shards.

matt_sre: agreed. I'll keep the override active for 60m and extend if metrics still trending. putting a watch on errors and GPU restarts.

deepa-plat: next actions (owners):
- kevin-platform: collect eviction top-n keys and identify offending app patterns -> action by +2h
- platform infra: evaluate pinned-shard feature -> action by +48h
- eng/release: patch tenantctl to allow soft write throttles -> action by +24h
- customer success: coordinate with OpalTech on backlog and mitigation steps -> action by +1h

jessica-m: handing incident to matt_sre for overnight monitoring and follow-up. I'm stepping off but reachable. summary pinned in incident doc: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/RB-32405 (internal).

matt_sre: acked, taking over. will post updates every 30m or on notable changes. leaving channel for now to reduce noise — will rejoin if alarms re-fire. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident RB-32405 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Escalation level lowered.

jessica-m: thanks team. closing pager for primary on-call. handoff complete. :handshake:
